title: Zesty Shattering Kenyan Bean Stew
description: A punchy, umami-packed stew that shatters cravings and soothes hangovers, using tender Chinese long beans, tomato broth, and citrusy aromatics. Nut‑free and flavorful, it delivers a zesty burst with every bite.

ingredients.name: Chinese long beans
ingredients.notes: trim and cut into 2 cm pieces

instructions: Wash and trim the long beans, then cut into 2 cm pieces.
In a large pot, heat a splash of oil and sauté the ginger, garlic, and chili flakes until fragrant.
Add the tomato paste and stir for 2 minutes to deepen the flavor.
Pour in the vegetable stock and bring the mixture to a gentle boil.
Add the long beans and cannellini beans, reduce heat, and simmer for 15 minutes or until the beans are tender.
Stir in soy sauce, lemon juice, and season with salt and pepper to taste.
Simmer for an additional 5 minutes to meld the flavors.
Garnish with fresh coriander before serving hot.
